archive.rationale: Third-party copyrighted texts. The archive lives in the working tree but is gitignored; this manifest is committed so presence, identity, and integrity are verifiable without publishing the content. Per md/RERUN.md section 1, the SHA-256 is what makes a future run verifiable, not the location.
archive.state: populated: 3 of 4 sources acquired (01, 02, 04); 03 excluded by decision

reproducibility.chain: archived raw HTML -> tools/extract-source-text.mjs -> the .txt whose SHA-256 is recorded here
reproducibility.note: The extractor is committed (it is our code, not third-party text) so anyone holding the archived HTML can regenerate the exact analyzed text and check it against these hashes. Extraction was deliberately NOT done by a model reading the page: a model-mediated transcription is not reproducible byte-for-byte and would break the chain. Each source's sidecar records its exact command line, plus the SHA-256 of the raw HTML it was run against.

epoch.note: Read from fixtures/demo-v2.2.0-canon-62c5cb511433.json provenance, not from memory. This is the post-alias-pass canon, not the 1.0.0+8c38a2f1d015 the run-01 corpus was analyzed against. This epoch describes the instrument at acquisition time; the re-run epoch is set when exports land.

acquisition.authorization: Jason GO for sources 01, 04, 02. Source 03 (Gottman, The Four Horsemen) EXCLUDED from re-acquisition by explicit decision: it remains a v2.1.2 artifact, flagged within-version-only, and no Gottman revision is to be fetched.
acquisition.note: All three acquired sources are capturedBy 'reacquired'. Nothing acquired now can be byte-verified against what was analyzed in July 2026 — the staging was deleted — so every re-run supersedes its predecessor rather than reproducing it. The prospective payoff is that from this commit forward, every future re-run is a true reproduction.

acquisition.notes: The worksheet recorded no URL. The permalink was recovered by Wayback CDX domain search and is 2011-12-21, not the 2011-09-13 first guess. Wayback rather than live, per the worksheet: a self-hosted post can be silently edited and has no dated archival slug. 73% of this source's words were set aside as non-domain in run 01, so the re-run population is small and sensitive to any text drift.

acquisition.consequence: The v2.1.2 result (885 words, 17 claim-like, 0 mapped) stands as a v2.1.2 artifact and may be cited ONLY within that version. It must not be compared against v2.3.0 results for the other three sources, and the corpus is therefore NOT single-version in the sense of md/RERUN.md section 6.
acquisition.notes: Highest drift risk of the four and the weakest surviving provenance: no year, no URL, and 'The Four Horsemen' names a commercial content-marketing article Gottman has published in several revised versions across more than one URL. This run produced the dossier's single most diagnostic result, so a re-run against a different revision would silently replace that evidence rather than reproduce it. Exclusion is the conservative call and preserves the finding intact.
